verdict.rationale: An llms.txt exists on the help center (help.drata.com/llms.txt, which indexes help articles such as the implementation guide), so an agent has a machine-oriented entry point to the product docs. However, the developer portal returns 404 for llms.txt, markdown docs and machine-readable OpenAPI paths, so the API docs are not agent-oriented. The MCP server documentation is an integration capability rather than agent-oriented docs, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: llms.txt or markdown docs on developers.drata.com, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable path, evidence of what the help-center llms.txt actually covers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
